name: Shichiya no Yume -Day after day-
source:
The story of your everyday life with Rose, a continuation of Seven Nights Dream.

No serious or deep story, just simple flirting and sex.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE262414.html]DLsite English[/url]]

没有严肃深刻的剧情，只有单纯的调情与性爱。
